address: 8 High Street, Hitchin, SG5 1BH, United Kingdom

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Standing out on Hitchin High Street with its black-and-white timbered facade, The Cock offers a delightful mix of pub and restaurant. An inn of some kind has stood on this spot since 1563 and there’s still a sense of history and character to the inviting front bar, while the rear dining room has a cool, clubby feel. The menu kicks off strongly with sweet brioche bread and subtly Marmite-flavoured butter, before launching into carefully prepared dishes such as hake with asparagus and a flavour-packed shellfish bisque. For a special occasion, hire the small converted barn.
